title: a registered hook whose jitso is not on PATH fails the hooks check
source: intended: B4B5-DESIGN.md B4-22 and the doctor spec (defect N-20): a read-only health check
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-20, B4.5). After `setup hook --yes` the hook command is the bare word `jitso`. With no `jitso` on the sandbox PATH the guard cannot start (and lets every call through), so doctor prints `fail hooks: jitso is not on PATH` and exits 3. The oracle has no `doctor` command: it answers `unknown command "doctor"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every pinned line FAILS on it.

stdout.regex: (?m)^fail hooks: jitso is not on PATH
